mapper.sql: select log_id, job_code, job_name, trigger_type, status, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, affected_rows, result_summary, error_message from sys_operation_schedule_log
mapper.select: select t.log_id, t.job_code, t.job_name, t.trigger_type, t.status, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.duration_ms, t.affected_rows, t.result_summary, t.error_message from sys_operation_schedule_log t inner join ( select job_code, max(log_id) as max_log_id from sys_operation_schedule_log group by job_code ) latest on t.log_id = latest.max_log_id order by t.started_at desc
select count(*) from sys_operation_schedule_log where status in ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL') and started_at >= date_sub(now(), interval 24 hour)
where status in ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL') order by started_at desc limit 50
